// what this is: The guard's configuration for the synthetic lab workload — the stand-in for a client's application.
Nothing here is recognised by name: the guard knows MetricIndex.LatencyP95Ms, the cluster exports
labapp_request_duration_seconds, and this file is the only thing that connects them. That is the point.
CpuThrottleRatio comes from cadvisor rather than the app, and is unbound here because no pod carries
a CPU limit. OomEventsRate comes from kube-state-metrics; see its own comment for why not cadvisor.
app's own error counter over its request counter, which the map cannot express as a single source, so it
is left out and reported blind.

OomEventsRate.query: sum by (pod) (increase(kube_pod_container_status_restarts_total{%selector%}[2m]) * on (namespace, pod, container) group_left() kube_pod_container_status_last_terminated_reason{%selector%,reason="OOMKilled"}) or sum by (pod) (increase(kube_pod_container_status_restarts_total{%selector%}[2m]) * 0)
_comment: NOT container_oom_events_total. Measured 2026-08-08 against a pod Kubernetes reported as OOMKilled
with exit 137: that series read 0 for the killed pod, and across 43 series cluster-wide over an hour
the only distinct value present was 0.0 - cAdvisor does not populate it on this runtime. The channel
bound, reported a number, satisfied every coverage check and could never fire.
kube-state-metrics carries the fact in two series: the restart increase says an event happened inside
the window, the last-terminated reason says it was an OOM. A name and a kind cannot express a join,
which is why 'query' exists. Verbatim queries carry their own range - keep [2m] in step with
ActiveRequests closes the hung-request gap: a request only enters the duration histogram when it
FINISHES, so while one hangs every latency percentile stays quiet. Measured 2026-08-09 with five
requests deliberately hung: labapp_active_requests read 6 while the histogram count read 0.
The exporter subtracts the scrape itself, so 0 means idle. Before that subtraction every pod
reported a flat 1.0 and the observer dominated the signal.
Floors from measurement: at rest 0 on all twelve pods, ten-minute maxima 0/1/2.
